plan.title: Reject Auction Start Price Below Maximum Global Charge

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ on the buyer's summary page.
Open the RFQ conversion flow and continue to the converted auction create screen.

args.goal: Set the converted auction's starting price below the largest global charge from the RFQ bids, publish the auction, and stop when the screen shows the refusal.

steps.note: No dedicated catalog step can edit this conversion-specific starting-price control and submit the converted auction.
